decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the independently entailed change to all-grade coverage, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
Expanding the content-generation prompt to the entire all-grade mini-game does not change the existing rule requiring a distinct object per level.
The source changes prompt scope but does not add, remove, or alter any supported visual representation type or classification rule.
Using ChatGPT to automate content work neither resumes nor replaces the separately deferred C# constrained random generator.
The source concerns Toy Factory prompt and grade coverage and does not alter the sorting activity's classifications, number range, or arithmetic problem types.
All-grade prompt coverage does not change the level-segmentation rule or resolve the outstanding number-of-levels ambiguity.
The source does not change the requirement to provide one question specification per level.
The broader prompt scope does not alter how questions associated with multiple levels must be repeated in the spreadsheet.
The source establishes all-grade Toy Factory coverage but does not modify the curriculum-alignment rule or resolve which listed topics belong in Grade 2.
